    lines=frame.ascii.split('\n')

def redcol(frame):
    lines=frame.ascii.split('\n')
    rs=[c for r in range(len(lines)) for c in range(len(lines[0])) if lines[r][c]=='R']
    if not rs: return None
    return round(sum(rs)/len(rs)/6)  # block col
def pcol(frame):
    lines=frame.ascii.split('\n')
    ps=[(r,c) for r in range(len(lines)) for c in range(len(lines[0])) if lines[r][c] in 'bc']
    if not ps: return None
    r=ps[0][0]; c=ps[0][1]
    return (round((r-22)/6), round((c-12)/6))  # (blockrow, blockcol)
